Edit request: make it green

Current program:
1| app "Water" drop ocean
2| table drink ml num 1..5000 unit "ml", kind pick Water|Tea|Juice|Milk = Water
3| setting goal num = 2000 "Daily goal (ml)"
4| let ml = sum(drink.ml today)
5| let p = clamp(ml / goal, 0, 1)
6| row gap 4 align center
7|   draw 56, 108 width 88
8|     rect 8, 104 - 100 * p, 40, 100 * p fill accent
9|     path "M6 4h44l-6 100H12z" stroke ink thick 2
10|   stack grow gap 1
11|     ml "ml" big
12|     "of" goal "ml today" color muted tap edit goal
13|     if ml >= goal
14|       "Goal reached" bold color good
15|     else
16|       text goal - ml "ml to go" bold
17| row gap 1
18|   button "+ 250 ml" fill accent grow tap add drink ml = 250
19|   button "+ 150 ml" grow tap add drink ml = 150
20|   button "+ 500 ml" grow tap add drink ml = 500
21| section "Today", plural(count(drink today), "drink")
22|   each drink today as d empty "Nothing yet today. Tap + 250 ml when you have a glass."
23|     row tap edit d swipe remove d
24|       d.kind grow
25|       d.ml "ml" bold
26| section "Last 7 days", "Goal met on" count(days last 7 days, sum(drink.ml on it) >= goal) "of 7 days"
27|   goalbars last 7 days, sum(drink.ml on it), goal, "Reached the goal (the dark line)"

3| table absent student ref student

19|     count(s.absent month of d) "days absent this month" faint
20| form student, "Add student"
